business_problem: AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across their consumer digital platforms.
solution_summary: AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally who pay for the most accurate weather forecasts than from any other known source. Faced with the challenge of ingesting, processing and storing immense volumes of diverse weather data at scale, AccuWeather turned to Databricks and Lakeflow Jobs, working with Datadog for observability.

solution_components.name: Delta Sharing
solution_components.role: Delivers governed data access across agencies, partners, or business units without copying datasets.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow Jobs
solution_components.role: Schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and production jobs.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow
solution_components.role: Coordinates ingestion and transformation workflows across the lakehouse.

data_flow: Operational, customer, and transactional data lands in Databricks, is transformed in the lakehouse, with pipelines coordinated through Databricks orchestration and transformation services, and is served to downstream users and applications through Delta Sharing.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 3x Faster dataset development; 50% Reduction in unactionable alerts.
architecture_clues: Uses Delta Sharing for governed data access across teams or partners.
